---
title: "Pipeline"
---

These "how-to" articles walk through `moRphoTaxa`'s full pipeline. The diagram below gives the overall shape of that workflow before you dive into the individual guides, each of which includes the original R script.

::: {.workflow-figure}
![](/figures/moRphoTaxa_workflow.svg){fig-alt="moRphoTaxa workflow diagram: herbarium data retrieval, occurrence cleaning, construction of the morphometric and ecogeographic matrices, and morphometric and ecogeographic inference"}
:::

::: {.pipeline-steps}
::: {.pipeline-step}
### 1. Get herbarium data
Retrieve specimen records from REFLORA, JABOT, speciesLink and GBIF.

[Get herbarium data →](/pipeline/1_get_herbarium_specimens.qmd)
:::

::: {.pipeline-step}
### 2. Clean occurrence data
Merge sources, remove duplicates and standardize names.

[Clean occurrence data →](/pipeline/2_clean_data.qmd)
:::

::: {.pipeline-step}
### 3. Add morphological traits
Build the trait template and the morphometric matrix.

[Add morphological traits →](/pipeline/3_add_morphological_traits.qmd)
:::

::: {.pipeline-step}
### 4. Run analysis
Morphometric, ecogeographic and niche analyses.

[Run analysis →](/pipeline/4_analysis.qmd)
:::
:::
